provenance_context.discovery: International Diabetes Federation (IDF) 11th Edition official country pages returned by 2026-11-10 public search results
provenance_context.scope: 32 African and Asia-Pacific country-specific institutional diabetes prevalence data profiles
provenance_context.limitations: These are 32 geographically distinct source URLs from the same 2025 IDF Atlas dataset, NOT 32 independent epidemiological studies. Some profiles extrapolate estimates from other countries. Search-result excerpts only; country source data, method, publication date and evidentiary quality not independently verified. No clinical evidence approval or medical integration.
provenance_context.queue_note: P1 country-condition diabetes population-health cells; no substantive research backlog decrement. One direct fetch of Comoros page encountered redirect loop; indexed metadata remains available.
